name: Model: Phases and Metadata
modt_content:
system
    name MetadataTest

obj Account
    +balance: decimal [a, db(DECIMAL(10,2))]
    -password: string [d, db(VARCHAR(255))]
    +id: int [a, d, db(SERIAL)]

    method Withdraw(amount: decimal) [a, d]
        pre balance >= amount
        post balance -= amount

    method Audit() [d]
        pre balance > 1000000
        post true
